visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a white cat with blue eyes sleeping soundly on a person's lap. The cat is wearing a pink collar with a bell. The background is a dimly lit indoor room with warm tones. (2) A sharp visual transition occurs as red exclamation marks and 'Z' symbols appear above the cat's head. The cat suddenly wakes up and turns its head toward the camera, its eyes wide and pupils dilated. (3) The camera focuses on the cat's face as a hand enters the frame and gently strokes the cat's head. The cat leans into the touch, looking slightly annoyed but alert. (4) A graphical transition shows a small white kitten walking against a solid yellow background, serving as a time-leap indicator. (5) The scene returns to the indoor setting, showing the same white cat, now visibly larger and older, sleeping in the exact same posture on the person's lap. (6) Red exclamation marks reappear. The cat wakes up even more dramatically than before, letting out a wide yawn with its mouth fully open, revealing its teeth and pink tongue. (7) The hand strokes the cat's head again. The cat looks directly at the camera with a calm, experienced gaze. (8) The video concludes with a white screen displaying a cartoon cat logo and brand text.
